prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too optimistic for high forecasts, while zero or negative predictions underpredicted major wins.
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across all 3 tests.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) yielded mixed results, winning in 2 tests (+4.6% and +6.6%) but performing worse in 2 others (-4.6% and -5.5%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) produced inconsistent results, winning in 3 tests (+6.1%, +4.7%, and +6.2%) while performing worse in 2 others (-4.4% and -9.3%).
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout (1 win, 1 no clear effect), choose_path copy (1 win, 1 worse), and all single-test categories, as at least 2 agreeing tests are needed to establish a pattern.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Launch Step New Screen: Add a dedicated desktop launch screen right before final completion to explain desktop overlay behavior and initial placement. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop upon launch, and overall finish conversion is lowest at 68.0%.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Companion Sound Selection Sub-Flow: Integrate an interactive pet voice sound selection sub-flow directly into the pet selection screen. (why: Adoption has high time spent (1017s mean), and users frequently ask for more custom pet interactivity and options.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Pulse Indicator: Add a visual progress indicator component to the waiting screen during pet asset generation. (why: The waiting stage in home has a 201s median time and 2336s mean time, requiring clear active feedback.)
3: [adoption, copy] Upload Photo Guidance Headline Update: Update the headline and instructions on the photo upload screen for maximum visual clarity. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failures or incorrect appearance from bad photo inputs.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Shortcut Control Hint: Display a explicit hint banner on the home intro screen showing how to summon or minimize the pet. (why: 3 support emails complained about lack of clarity on how to hide, show, or control the pet on desktop.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Narrative Welcome Copy: Refine narrative copy on the initial story screen to set clear expectations before choosing a path. (why: Choose path step has a high mean duration (514s); clearer upfront context will speed up path decision making.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen to the finish step historically severely reduced conversion (-15.4%).
Adding multi-step sub-flows introduces friction and extra screens, which tend to perform poorly.
